answer: Paired-Identity Attestation Ledger.** Each agent must publish a signed statement linking its operational key to a distinct physical resource draw (power meter reading, radio fingerprint, or hardware serial) recorded on a shared ledger. A duplicate hardware identity creates a conflicting entry, so a sybil needs separate physical devices per identity—a ledge of real capital it cannot cheaply copy.
